trial_court: VI Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru in M.C.No.1521/2012
case_name: Sri Sreedhara H L vs Smt Manasi S H
facts_of_case: The parties have been living separately since 12 years and have not been able to live together. They have mutually agreed that the marriage should be dissolved.

legal_principles.principle: A compromise petition under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 can be allowed in modification of a previous judgment and order.
legal_principles.held: Learned Counsel on both sides submit that the parties have arrived at a settlement as per the compromise petition dated 28.02.2018.

legal_principles.principle: A court can waive the statutory period provided under Section 13B(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 in exceptional circumstances.
legal_principles.held: Having regard to the facts of the case, we accept the application and waive the statutory period provided under Section 13B(2) of the Act.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is restored to file, and the statutory period provided under Section 13B(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is waived. The parties' compromise petition dated 28.02.2018 is accepted, and the judgment and decree dated 04.03.2016 passed by the trial court are modified.

keywords: Latin Maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: drafting a divorce appeal under Hindu Marriage Act
responding to a petition for restoration of an appeal
